title: A Lament for Pharaoh and Egypt

questions.question: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, what did God command Ezekiel to raise over Pharaoh king of Egypt?
options: A lamentation
A standard of war
A song of praise
A riddle
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:2 (ESV): "Son of man, raise a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt..."

questions.question: Pharaoh considered himself like a lion among the nations, but what does God say he actually is?
options: "You are like a dragon in the seas; you burst forth in your rivers, trouble the waters with your feet, and foul their rivers."
"You are like a jackal scavenging the desert."
"You are a snake hiding in the reeds of the Nile."
"You are like a wild ox caught in a snare."
questions.correctAnswer: "You are like a dragon in the seas; you burst forth in your rivers, trouble the waters with your feet, and foul their rivers."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:2 (ESV): "You consider yourself a lion of the nations, but you are like a dragon in the seas; you burst forth in your rivers, trouble the waters with your feet, and foul their rivers."

questions.question: How will God capture this dragon of the seas?
options: "I will throw my net over you with a host of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet."
"I will drain the Nile until it is dry bone."
"I will send the king of Babylon to pierce it with a spear."
"I will blind its eyes with sand from the desert."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will throw my net over you with a host of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:3 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: I will throw my net over you with a host of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet."

questions.question: What will the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the whole earth do with Pharaoh's carcass once he is cast into the open field?
options: They will settle on him and gorge themselves on him
They will flee from his stench
They will bury him under the sand
They will leave him untouched as a monument
questions.correctAnswer: They will settle on him and gorge themselves on him
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:4 (ESV): "And I will cast you on the ground; on the open field I will fling you... and I will gorge the beasts of the whole earth with you."

questions.question: What celestial phenomenon will God cause when He blots out Pharaoh?
options: "I will cover the heavens and make their stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light."
"I will cause a great comet to strike the earth."
"I will make the sun stand still in the sky."
"I will rain fire and sulfur upon the cities."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will cover the heavens and make their stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:7 (ESV): "When I blot you out, I will cover the heavens and make their stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light."

questions.question: God says He will trouble the hearts of many peoples when He brings Pharaoh's destruction among the nations. How will kings react?
options: "Their kings will be shuddering with fear precisely for you, when I brandish my sword before them."
"Their kings will send vast sums of gold to appease Me."
"Their kings will rejoice at his downfall."
"Their kings will declare war on Babylon."
questions.correctAnswer: "Their kings will be shuddering with fear precisely for you, when I brandish my sword before them."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:10 (ESV): "I will make many peoples appalled at you, and the hair of their kings will bristle with horror because of you... every one of them will tremble every moment for his life on the day of your downfall."

questions.question: Whose sword specifically will God bring upon Pharaoh and his multitude?
options: The sword of the king of Babylon
The sword of the king of Persia
The sword of Michael the archangel
The sword of David
questions.correctAnswer: The sword of the king of Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:11 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord God: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you."

questions.question: What will happen to the muddy waters of Egypt when their beasts are destroyed beside the many waters? God will make their waters clear, and their rivers run like...
options: Oil
Blood
Wine
Crystal
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:14 (ESV): "Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, declares the Lord God."

questions.question: In the second lament of the chapter, whom is Ezekiel told to "send down" Egypt and her multitudes?
options: To the world below, with those who go down to the pit
To the prisons of Babylon
To the depths of the Mediterranean sea
To the barren mountains of Seir
questions.correctAnswer: To the world below, with those who go down to the pit
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:18 (ESV): "Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and send them down, her and the daughters of majestic nations, to the world below, to those who have gone down to the pit:"

questions.question: With whom will Egypt lie in the pit?
options: With the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword
With the righteous kings of Judah
With the angels who rebelled
With the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
questions.correctAnswer: With the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:19 (ESV): "Are you more beautiful than any other? Go down and be laid to rest with the uncircumcised."

questions.question: Who will greet Pharaoh and his helpers from the midst of Sheol?
options: The mighty chiefs
The kings of Israel
The prophets he killed
The demon Beelzebub
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:21 (ESV): "The mighty chiefs shall speak of them, with their helpers, out of the midst of Sheol: 'They have come down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.'"

questions.question: Which of the following fallen nations is mentioned as already being in the pit, having spread terror in the land of the living, but now bearing their shame with those who go down to the pit?
options: Assyria
Rome
Greece
Spain
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:22 (ESV): "Assyria is there, and all her company, its graves all around it, all of them slain, fallen by the sword,"

questions.question: Another nation mentioned in the pit is Elam. How is Elam's multitude described?
options: Slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised into the world below
Sitting on thrones of gold but unable to speak
Burning in an eternal fire
Chained to rocks in utter darkness
questions.correctAnswer: Slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised into the world below
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:24 (ESV): "Elam is there, and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised into the world below..."

questions.question: Who else is mentioned as being in the pit with their graves around them?
options: Meshech-Tubal, Edom, and the princes of the north/Sidonians
The Philistines, Ammonites, and Moabites
The Hittites and Jebusites
The Canaanites and Amorites
questions.correctAnswer: Meshech-Tubal, Edom, and the princes of the north/Sidonians
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:26, 29, 30 lists Meshech-Tubal (26), Edom (29), and the princes of the north and the Sidonians (30).

questions.question: What will happen when Pharaoh sees all these fallen nations in Sheol?
options: He will be comforted for all his multitude
He will weep uncontrollably forever
He will attempt to conquer Sheol
He will ask God for forgiveness
questions.correctAnswer: He will be comforted for all his multitude
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 32:31 (ESV): "When Pharaoh sees them, he will be comforted for all his multitude, Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord God."

key_verse_text: "Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and send them down, her and the daughters of majestic nations, to the world below, to those who have gone down to the pit:"
